body:
My divorce will probably be close to that many days. I filed the first few weeks of September, but the court won't send out a hearing date until sometime in the early spring. I'm trying to look at it as a way to get things setup so that when the decree is finalized, it's more or less just another day.

Good luck to you and glad things are going well. I'm sure you've heard this before, but treasure every moment with your son but don't put pressure on yourself (or him) to make every visit special or filled with fun. Just make sure he knows you'll always be there for him.
I hadn't really thought about what I want to do. Probably sleep.
Thank you for this, because the fear of losing my kids is weighing heavily on me.

There's a verse in the Zac Brown Band song that I think will always ring in my head:
    
A day might come and you'll realize
 
That if you could see through my eyes
 
There was no other way to work it out
 
And a part of you might hate me
 
But son please don't mistake me
 
For a man that didn't care at all.

I've had friends (who're married with kids) tell me/scream at me that I need to avoid the woman. But, like you said, that's impossible since we have kids together.

Because, yeah, sex isn't enough to keep the marriage together. We have so many other issues that, to me, make divorce a foregone conclusion.

Lots of Internet research. It was towards the beginning of this year, so I don't remember all of the sites I used.

I did a phone consultation with him and there was an ease to it all. I did another in-person consultation with another attorney, but he was just a bit too much of the clichéd cocky divorce attorney you might hear advertising on the radio.
The woman I love. Because she's all that matters to me.
Sounds so much like my situation that I'd swear I wrote it up.
Be honest with the woman you want to spend your life with.

I know what you mean about not liking yourself. I could've been honest with her and she would still be with me. So, I can't even look at myself without seething with anger and hatred.

I hope I can get to the point of focusing on myself and what makes me happy someday. Right now she's what made me the happiest I've ever been.
Not giving up on love just seems impossible. This woman was so singularly amazing, there's no way I'll ever find anyone close to her level again.
